limitations: Finite fixed d, isotropic Poisson reorientation, independent stable inverse time-change. Existence, not uniqueness, of finite-time crossing for orders above the threshold; no all-time sign statement at or below threshold. General prior transform formulas may imply moment specializations; scholarly priority remains reviewable.
scientific_integrity: Analytic proof based on finite polynomial generator moment equations and inverse-stable scaling; numerical tests are supportive, not an infinite certification. The fractional kinetic model and subordinated motion are attributed to earlier work.
title: A sharp dimensional kurtosis boundary for inverse-stable run-and-tumble transport
